job0.title: EXCLAIM RECOVERY — 首席技术官（远程）
bullets: Led architecture and full refactor of a multi-platform system (web, mobile, AI backend), significantly improving performance, scalability, and maintainability.

Built and scaled a peer-support platform for gambling addiction, supporting hundreds of active users and processing thousands of messages, including real-time chat, AI-assisted guidance, and a full reporting and moderation system; stress-tested by Gaming Laboratories International (GLI) and referenced in external publications.
Improved AI system performance by ~90%, optimizing latency and throughput for real-time LLM-driven interactions.
Designed and deployed a monorepo powering a Next.js web app, React Native mobile app, and AI services backed by PostgreSQL/Prisma.
Built and scaled "Hope AI," an LLM-powered system using LangGraph with multi-source RAG, long-term memory, and behavioral analysis pipelines.
Implemented real-time systems (Ably) and full authentication architecture (NextAuth, OAuth, JWT) across platforms.
Delivered 500+ production PRs, driving rapid iteration and system reliability.

job1.title: Tulane School of Architecture — SEO & Analytics Consultant
bullets: Conducted large-scale technical SEO audits across 4,000+ URLs, identifying and resolving crawl errors, metadata inconsistencies, and indexation issues.
Reduced crawl inefficiencies by removing low-value and broken pages from sitemap, improving site health and search visibility.
Implemented GA4 + GTM event tracking for admissions funnels and user engagement, enabling end-to-end visibility into user journeys and conversion intent.
Built analytics dashboards (Looker Studio) to track program interest, admissions funnel performance, and student engagement.
Improved site structure and content organization to better capture and analyze prospective student behavior.

job2.title: EXCLAIM RECOVERY — 技术负责人（远程）
bullets: Built AI-driven systems for sentiment analysis, crisis detection, and behavioral tracking, enabling real-time intervention and improved user safety.
Developed agent-based architectures using LangGraph, OpenAI, and LangChain.
Designed scalable backend services with Node.js, Prisma, and PostgreSQL.

role1.title: FSG, Atlas360 — 顾问
bullets: Contributed to a distributed system supporting 15M+ passports and 4M+ visas annually across 70+ countries, ensuring high availability at global scale.
Built and optimized React-based UI integrated with Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Python APIs, enabling real-time, ML-assisted customer service workflows.
Improved ML-driven response classification accuracy by ~70% using FastText, delivering instant, context-aware responses and significantly increasing caseworker efficiency.
Engineered messaging and queue-based systems using Azure (including dead-letter queue handling) to support high-volume automated communications.
Developed a comprehensive automated testing suite for Microsoft Dynamics CRM, reducing manual QA effort and accelerating feature delivery and UX validation.
Supported global production deployments across multiple regions, collaborating with international teams under high-demand conditions.
Contributed to large-scale operational rollouts across countries, supporting customer service teams with extended coverage during critical launches.

role2.title: ESG, CAST — 顾问
bullets: Designed and implemented REST APIs using Java Spring Boot for a greenfield internal platform.
Developed Angular frontend components and integrated backend services.
Built unit testing suite (JUnit, Mockito) ensuring reliability of core business logic.
Modeled relational data using JPA and optimized data access patterns.

job4.title: OPERATION SPARK — 助教（远程）
bullets: Mentored students in software engineering, debugging, and problem-solving techniques.
